Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: AetherPress
Description: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Punchline: Automatically compress textures in newly installed Penumbra mods.
Changelog: Replaces adaptive scaling with measured 2K-safe presets, matches Mass Texture Downscaler conversion output, keeps skin protection, adds a cleaner settings layout, applies batches atomically, and records the actual MB saved in each compressed mod description.

Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Moves the selected-mod count beneath the animation list so selecting mods no longer shifts the library content downward.
